answer: Each identity locks 70 credits and posts one row on a public vine table: its knoll plot, its key, and its bond. Auditors walk the vine each epoch and re-check a random tenth of rows; a copied row, or one key on two rows, burns both bonds, and a plume stamp seals each verified row. First row 60; k-th 60+3(k-1). A farm posting 1,000 rows spends 1,558,500 and locks 70,000, chasing a 40,000 reward. One honest row costs 60 and the bond comes back.
